objective: For the class-3 group with x (alpha), y (alpha^-1), w (alpha^-1), [x, y] and [w, x] of trivial character and [w, [x, y]] = -[y, [w, x]] nonzero (no hard pair in any layer), measure on knot surgeries with H1 = Z/r whether the layer-3 obstruction (a twisted triple Massey product tested against V_alpha, a four-linear form) is nonzero and whether clasper-type insertions with eigenprojected leaves steer it as a Lie-symmetrized product of leaf functionals predicts, under a frozen contract.
status: Closed: supported under its frozen rule. Experiment BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001B-E001 measured the four-way form of G_p = U4(F_p) x| <diag(1,-1,1,-1)> on 2-surgeries of closed braids with two independent models. Base vanishing held on 15 sums of 4_1, 5_2 and T(2,p). Exact steering by the Magnus tensor with kappa = 2 held on 17 insertion fixtures (P4 and P4B, mixed, doubled, under-dragged and shifted insertions, p = 5, 7, 11, 13) and on two full level-model tables. The gadget formula held on K2, P3, the digon, K3, K1,3 and C4 at p = 5, 7, 11 (up to 788 crossings). Independent group-law counts on the Wirtinger presentations gave 390625, 390625, 244140625 and 1 as predicted, and the 40-sample lifting test agreed. All five negative controls failed to match. Report: research/BEYOND-CLASS2-20261027-001B/report.md.
title: Experiment: four-way Massey interactions on knot surgeries
